title: Crystal Growth Simulation
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D crystal growth simulation using Three.js in a single HTML file. The simulation should visualize crystals growing from seed points on a base platform.

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (color: 0x0a0a1a)
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 15), looking at origin
- OrbitControls for camera rotation/zoom
- A flat hexagonal base platform (radius 6, height 0.3) made of dark stone-like material (color: 0x1a1a2e) at y=0
- Ambient light (0x334466, intensity 0.3) and two point lights: one warm (0xff6644) at (10,15,5) intensity 0.8, one cool (0x4466ff) at (-10,12,-5) intensity 0.6
- Add subtle fog (0x0a0a1a, near 20, far 50)

## Crystal System
- Crystals are built from elongated octahedron geometries (ConeGeometry top + bottom or custom geometry). Use IcosahedronGeometry with detail 0 scaled along Y axis (scaleY 2.5-4.0 randomly) as crystal shards.
- Crystal material: MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 0.6, roughness 0.1, metalness 0.1, transparent true, opacity 0.85. Color varies by crystal type.
- Three crystal color types: Amethyst (0x9b59b6), Emerald (0x2ecc71), Sapphire (0x3498db)
- Each crystal shard starts at scale 0 and grows to its target scale over 2 seconds with easing
- Crystals grow in clusters: each cluster has a center point and 5-12 shards radiating outward at various angles
- Maximum 5 clusters, maximum 60 total shards

## Growth Mechanics
- Click on the base platform to place a seed point. A small glowing sphere appears at the click location.
- After placing a seed, crystal shards begin growing from that point over time (one new shard every 300ms)
- Each shard grows upward with a random tilt (0-30 degrees from vertical) and random rotation
- Growth speed can be adjusted with a slider (0.5x to 3.0x, default 1.0x)
- Press 'G' to toggle auto-growth mode: in auto mode, new shards keep growing from existing clusters randomly
- Press 'F' to freeze/unfreeze all growth animation

## Crystal Selection & Interaction
- Press '1', '2', '3' to select crystal type (Amethyst, Emerald, Sapphire respectively)
- Current selected type determines the color of the next placed cluster
- Press 'R' to rotate all crystals slowly (toggle rotation animation at 0.3 rad/s around Y)
- Press 'C' to clear all crystals and reset
- Press 'L' to toggle a pulsing inner glow effect (point light at each cluster center that pulses intensity 0-2 over 2 second cycle)

## Particle Effects
- Each growing crystal emits small sparkle particles (small spheres, 20 per cluster) that float upward and fade
- Particles use additive blending and match the crystal color
- Particle lifetime: 2 seconds, moving upward at speed 0.5-1.5

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: DOM overlay showing 'Clusters: X/5' and 'Shards: X/60'
- Top-right: Current crystal type name and colored indicator square
- Bottom-center: Growth speed slider with label 'Growth Speed: X.Xx'
- Bottom-left: Status indicators for 'Auto-Growth: ON/OFF', 'Frozen: YES/NO', 'Rotation: ON/OFF', 'Glow: ON/OFF'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- clusterCount: number of placed clusters (0-5)
- shardCount: total number of crystal shards
- selectedType: string ('amethyst'|'emerald'|'sapphire')
- selectedTypeIndex: number (1, 2, or 3)
- growthSpeed: number (0.5 to 3.0)
- autoGrowth: boolean
- frozen: boolean
- rotating: boolean
- glowEnabled: boolean
- lastClusterPosition: {x, y, z} or null
- averageShardScale: number (average current scale of all shards, 0-1 range where 1 is fully grown)
- particleCount: number of active particles
- totalClusters: array of objects with {x, z, type, shardCount}
- isNaNFree: boolean (true if no NaN in any crystal position)
physics_constraints: Crystal shards must grow smoothly from scale 0 to target scale. All positions must remain NaN-free. Crystals must stay within the hexagonal base platform radius. Growth speed multiplier affects animation timing proportionally. Maximum limits (5 clusters, 60 shards) must be enforced. Particle positions must not escape bounds (y < 20).
